name: m2t5b
description: Death-cleanup fixture on an open all-grass field: three player-one villagers gather wood from a node while a player-two militia is commanded to kill the middle villager. The victim pauses its chop to retaliate (its work-slot claim survives the pause), trades blows on the reload cadence and dies after the militia's seventh strike; the corpse loses every component row, the militia's engagement purges clean, and the surviving pair keeps chopping and depositing through tick 900 with exclusive slot claims and a closed resource ledger. Milestone digests land every 30th tick plus final; the run doubles as the extended determinism canary.
